sn40.4:1.4: idha bhikkhu sukhassa ca pahānā dukkhassa ca pahānā pubbeva somanassadomanassānaṃ atthaṅgamā adukkhamasukhaṃ upekkhāsatipārisuddhiṃ catutthajjhānaṃ upasampajja viharati
sn40.4:1.6: so khvāhaṃ āvuso sukhassa ca pahānā dukkhassa ca pahānā pubbeva somanassadomanassānaṃ atthaṅgamā adukkhamasukhaṃ upekkhāsatipārisuddhiṃ catutthajjhānaṃ upasampajja viharāmi.
sn40.4:1.7: tassa mayhaṃ āvuso iminā vihārena viharato sukhasahagatā saññāmanasikārā samudācaranti.
sn40.4:2.1: atha kho maṃ āvuso bhagavā iddhiyā upasaṅkamitvā etadavoca
sn40.4:2.3: mā brāhmaṇa catutthajjhānaṃ pamādo catutthajjhāne cittaṃ saṇṭhapehi catutthajjhāne cittaṃ ekodiṃ karohi catutthajjhāne cittaṃ samādahāti.
sn40.4:2.4: so khvāhaṃ āvuso aparena samayena sukhassa ca pahānā dukkhassa ca pahānā pubbeva somanassadomanassānaṃ atthaṅgamā adukkhamasukhaṃ upekkhāsatipārisuddhiṃ catutthajjhānaṃ upasampajja vihāsiṃ.
sn40.4:2.5: yaṃ hi taṃ āvuso sammā vadamāno vadeyya …pe… mahābhiññataṃ pattoti.
